_readme: One entry per close-up photo of ONE part (crop it so the part fills most of the frame, as the app does). Put photos in test-set/photos/ (gitignored by default). expected.verdict: looks_right | possible_problem. expected.issue when there is a problem: flipped, missing, bridged, lifted_lead, insufficient_solder, excess_solder, cold_joint, tombstoned, misaligned, wrong_part, other. marking for polarized parts: pin1, cathode, tantalum, electrolytic. The two entries below are examples: replace them with real photos.
